title: 第4章 药奴
content_zh:
潺潺水流，绿树成荫，一头地龙在澄净的小河边饮水，身上挂满了大大小小的包裹。

在地龙旁边，十几个身形彪悍的武者正在大快朵颐，吃的不亦乐乎，讲着少儿不宜的话题。地龙身后，同样有十几个瘦骨嶙峋的人，这些人手脚都带着沉重的镣铐，蹲在地上，目光无神的低头吃着没什么营养的食物。

地龙身上的一架轿子内，一个神情阴冷的老者，着一身黑灰色的长袍，长袍的胸口位置绣着五个精巧的白药瓶，老者身形消瘦，头戴发冠，居高临下地俯视着那些带着镣铐的人，像是在挑选待宰的猪样。

老者目光游弋不定，有时会落到那些大吃大喝的武者身上，露出耐人寻味的阴森眼神，每一个被他注视到的武者，都会脸色巨变，噤若寒蝉，似乎非常惧怕他。

“吃完了没？吃完了就继续上路。”墨颜玉提着石岩，寒着脸从灌木丛中走过来。

众多武者干笑着收起手中未完的美食，连连道：“吃好了，吃好了。”

墨颜玉板着脸，满脸不耐，等来到了那老者身旁，才勉强露出笑脸，道：“卡鲁大师，您也吃好了吧？”

老者冷淡地点了点头，哼哼道：“墨小姐，离商盟还有三个月的路程，可你们找来的药奴却只剩下十六人了，我怕支撑不到商盟啊……”

“大师放心，路上我们会继续为您补充药奴。”墨颜玉一脸正色，随手将石岩扔到地上，微笑道：“你看，这不是又多了一个药奴么？”

“嗯。”卡鲁不冷不热地点了点头，目光如毒蛇一样在石岩的身上游荡了一遍，皱眉道：“这小子身子这么瘦，怕是支撑不了几天吧？”

“他身子的确瘦弱，不过，他体内有精元……”墨颜玉解释道。

“武者？”卡鲁眼睛微亮，明显有了点兴趣。

“这还差不多。”卡鲁阴森森地笑了，开始更加仔细地打量石岩，半响才缓缓点头：“很好，墨小姐给我喂饱他，我要他身体先强壮起来，一个重伤的武者可经不起我折腾，要是因为身体太弱早早就被我给药死了，那可就太浪费了。”

“大师放心。”墨颜玉黛眉煞气凝聚，轻叱道：“强森，还愣着做什么！还不快点给这家伙手脚戴上镣铐！”

“来了！”一个身高将近两米，满脸横肉的光头大汉，应了一声，迅速从地龙身上取出一副崭新的镣铐，粗暴地将镣铐夹在石岩的手脚上，根本不顾石岩会不会疼痛。

大汉身着重甲，重甲外**出来的肌肉鼓鼓胀胀，充满了惊人的爆炸力，他那一身暗黑色的重甲在他身上似乎轻如无物，一点不影响他的速度。

“强森，你给我好好照顾好他，别让他从队伍中拉下来了。”墨颜玉仇恨地望了石岩一眼，旋即直朝着队伍最前方行去，似乎不想在石岩身旁多呆一秒钟。

“小姐放心，这种事我最拿手了。”光头大汉强森咧嘴狞笑，捶胸保证。

石岩浑身酸麻，冷眼看着事态的发展，一言不发。

他知道在这种境况之下，说什么都是无用，在这个弱肉强食的世界，没有人会和你讲什么道理，他知道如果自己不去适应这个世界，他将会很快成为一具无人问津的白骨，没有人会可怜他。

体内微弱的精元缓缓流动，手脚的酸麻感经过这一段时间的歇息，已经好了许多，然而，手脚上多出来的镣铐却拖累了他，使得还没有恢复过来的身体像是背着一座铁山，让他举步艰难。

后背突然被皮鞭狠狠地抽了一鞭，那一鞭来的极为迅猛，力道极大，令他后背皮开肉裂，火辣辣的疼。回过头来，他就发现了那个名叫强森的大汉手提着皮鞭，正满脸狞笑地看着他。

“该死的药奴！还不快走！想再吃一鞭子么？”强森裂嘴，哈哈大笑。

石岩没有回话，而是异常冷静地看了强森几秒钟，在强森再次举鞭之前，才步履艰难地默默跟上前方的药奴，只觉每一步都重逾千斤，需要消耗他很大的力气。

石岩转身后，强森脸上的狂笑渐渐收敛，反倒露出古怪的表情。

这一路行来，有很多不老实的药奴一开始都是被他“照顾”的，因为他手段残暴狠毒，有两名药奴还未经过卡鲁试药，就在他的“照顾”下被活活打死了，所有药奴在看向他的时候，眼睛中显露出来的表情无非两种。

只有这人，刚刚在看向他的时候，既没有丝毫恐惧，也没有表现出应有的仇恨，而是异常的冷静，是那种带着点丝丝凉意的冷静。

这人似乎没有一点身为阶下囚的觉悟，不知道是因为还没有分清形势，还是别的原因。

那种冷静的目光，让强森有种自己成为了别人猎物的奇怪错觉，这让他很不舒服，但因为石岩已经老老实实往前走，他一时也找不着发作的借口，只能作罢，却在心底暗暗发誓，一定要在后面“照顾”的这小子对他露出恐惧之情。

他很享用别人看向他时，所显现出来的恐惧目光，这让他有种自己是别人生命掌握者的美妙快感。

接下来的几天，石岩沉默寡言，却极其配合，让他走就走，让他停就停，不做丝毫反抗，也没有一点情绪，似乎对周围的事情漠不关心，在那些不配合的药奴当中，石岩显得非常另类。

就连想要好好教训石岩的强森，都很难找到借口对付他，石岩实在是太配合了，配合的让强森都觉得不合常理，却又想不出个所以然来。

石岩只有在歇息吃饭的时候，才会开口讲话，每一次也都是索要食物，在卡鲁大师的吩咐下，他这个要求每次都给予满足。

很快，那些武者便发现石岩非常能吃，就连那些药奴专用的劣质食物，他都吃的津津有味，他第一次吃的食物大概就是七名药奴的总和，之后每过一天，他的食量都会增进一份，并且还有继续增加的趋势。

这让很多武者都觉得不可思议，他们想不通石岩那瘦弱的身体，怎么能够装下那么多食物，一开始这些人都担心石岩会消化不掉，但他们很快便发现自己错了。

石岩瘦的皮包骨头的身体，竟然在几天时间悄悄强壮了一些，虽然强壮的并不特别明显，但观察敏锐的武者都发现了这个现象。

很显然，石岩不但消化了那些劣质食物，还让那些食物成为了他身体强健的养分。

石岩的身体变化，让卡鲁大师很高兴，这个眼神阴森的老者特许石岩可以放心大胆的吃，能吃多少必须给多少，不能少一分。

眼见石岩一天天强壮起来，强森隐隐有些不安，每次看到石岩那带着点丝丝凉意的冷静眼神，强森都觉得这小子会是个祸害，但他又不敢违背卡鲁的吩咐，也只能没有克扣的为石岩奉上足够的食物。

还好强森知道卡鲁大师的手段，这让他多少有些放心，暗暗盼望卡鲁能早点动手。

一连吃了十二人份的食物，石岩才停下了手中动作，将嘴角最后一块米粒卷住咽下，无视旁边那些药奴惊异的目光，石岩慢慢闭上了眼。

十二人份的食物，在肠胃中被迅速消化，他身体像是一个无底洞，又像是最为精密的仪器，将那些食物一一研磨分解，转化为血液筋脉、骨骼、五脏六腑、肌肉细胞的养分，令他原本瘦弱的身体在悄声无息间强壮起来。

胸口的创伤，很早就恢复了，那么长的伤口，愈合只用了一天半的时间，并且没有留下一点疤痕，神奇无比，让他意识到自己的确和以前不同了。

也只有他自己清楚，在这短短几天的时间内，他的身体发生了多么巨大的变化，这种变化，他每一时每一刻都能够清晰的感觉体会到！

吃下去的食物化为身体的养分，令他身体渐渐精壮起来，存在体内的那一缕微弱的精元，在这几天日夜不休的运转流动之下，竟然壮大了一倍！

他明显察觉到身体中有了不小的力量，那原先沉重如山的镣铐，也早已经不再是他多大的负担了。

精神集中，他清晰的感觉到体内的精元，自然而然地从下丹田开始，循督脉而上，顺任脉而下，过三关沟通任督，使心肾相交，水火相济，一个小周天结束后，他体内精元再次壮大一分。

对气功常识多少有些了解的石岩，知道大小周天的区别，小周天只走任督二脉，不走十二正经，也不走其余奇经的另外六脉，但大周天不但要走十二正经，还要走另外六大奇脉，极其不易。

他十二正经、八大奇经中只通了任督两脉，只能进行小周天，大周天难以循环，从另外一个石岩的记忆中，他也知道在这个世界上只有先天之境的武者，才能够做到十二大正经和八大奇经畅通无阻，进而进行大周天循环。

石岩并不气馁，他知道只要体内的精元足够强大，早晚是可以将这些闭塞的筋脉全部打通的。

“又死了一个，六天时间，已经有两人试药而死了。”

“我看见了，那人还没死的时候，身体已经开始腐烂了，惨不忍睹啊！”

“与其这样死法，还不如自杀算了，活着也看不见希望，我们注定会和他们一样。”

“不能自杀！我们如果是自杀而死，我们的亲人连一个蓝晶币都得不到！哎……熬吧，熬过半年我们没死也就自由了，还能得到一笔钱，为了老婆和孩子，我们必须继续要熬下去！”

这个药奴的这句话一出，别的药奴一一沉默了下去，自杀的念头像是被打消了，都强忍着心中的恐惧，暗暗叮嘱自己必须撑下去。

content_en:
Gurgling water, shaded by green trees, an earth dragon drinking water by the clear river, its body covered with packages of all sizes.

Next to Earth Dragon, a dozen tough warriors were feasting on their food, enjoying the food and talking about topics not suitable for children.Behind Dilong, there were also a dozen skinny people, their hands and feet were heavily shackled, squatting on the ground, looking down and eating nutritious food.

In a sedan chair on Dilong's body, there was an old man with a cold expression, wearing a black and gray robe, with five exquisite white medicine bottles embroidered on the chest of the robe. The old man was thin and wearing a hair crown, looking down at the shackled people, as if he were selecting pigs to be slaughtered.

The old man's eyes wandered uncertainly, and sometimes he would fall on those warriors who were eating and drinking, revealing an intriguing and sinister look. Every warrior he looked at would have a huge change in their expressions, and they would remain silent, as if they were very afraid of him.

"Have you finished eating? Let's continue on the road after eating." Mo Yanyu carried Shi Yan and walked through the bushes with a cold face.

Many warriors smiled dryly and put away the unfinished delicacies in their hands, saying repeatedly: "Eat, eat."

Mo Yanyu had a stern face and was full of impatience. When she came to the old man's side, she forced a smile and said: "Master Karu, have you finished eating?"

The old man nodded coldly and hummed: "Miss Mo, we are still three months away from the Merchant Alliance, but there are only sixteen medicine slaves you have found left. I'm afraid I won't be able to support the Merchant Alliance..."

"Don't worry, Master, we will continue to replenish the medicine slaves for you on the way." Mo Yanyu looked serious, threw Shi Yan to the ground, and said with a smile: "Look, isn't there another medicine slave?"

"Yeah." Karu nodded lukewarmly, his eyes wandering over Shi Yan's body like a poisonous snake, and frowned: "This kid is so thin, I'm afraid he won't be able to support him for a few days, right?"

"He is indeed thin, but he has essence in his body..." Mo Yanyu explained.

"Warrior?" Kalu's eyes brightened slightly, and he was obviously a little interested.

"That's about the same." Kalu smiled sinisterly and began to look at Shi Yan more carefully. After a while, he nodded slowly: "Very good, Miss Mo, let me feed him. I want his body to get stronger first. A seriously injured warrior cannot withstand my torment. It would be a waste if I killed him early because he was too weak."

"Don't worry, Master." Mo Yanyu's dark eyebrows condensed with evil spirit, and she scolded: "Johnson, what are you still doing? Why don't you put shackles on this guy's hands and feet quickly!"

"Here we come!" A bald man nearly two meters tall with a sinewy face responded, quickly took out a brand new pair of shackles from Dilong's body, and roughly clamped the shackles on Shi Yan's hands and feet, not caring whether Shi Yan would be in pain.

The big man was wearing heavy armor, and the muscles protruding from the armor were bulging and full of astonishing explosive power. His dark black heavy armor seemed as light as nothing on his body, and it did not affect his speed at all.

"Johnson, take good care of him, don't let him be pulled from the team." Mo Yanyu glanced at Shi Yan with hatred, and then walked straight to the front of the team, as if she didn't want to stay beside Shi Yan for one more second.

"Don't worry, miss, I'm the best at this kind of thing." The bald man Johnson grinned and beat his chest in assurance.

Shi Yan felt sore all over and watched the development of the situation coldly without saying a word.

He knew that in this situation, anything he said was useless. In this world of the jungle, no one would reason with you. He knew that if he did not adapt to this world, he would soon become a skeleton that no one cares about, and no one would pity him.

The weak essence in his body flows slowly, and the soreness and numbness in his hands and feet has improved a lot after this period of rest. However, the extra shackles on his hands and feet are dragging him down, making his body that has not yet recovered feel like it is carrying an iron mountain on its back, making it difficult for him to move.

Suddenly, his back was severely whipped with a whip. The whip came extremely quickly and with great force, causing the skin and flesh on his back to split open and causing burning pain.When he turned around, he found the big man named Johnson holding a leather whip and looking at him with a sinister smile on his face.

"Damn medicine slave! Leave quickly! Do you want to be whipped again?" Johnson cracked his mouth and laughed.

Shi Yan did not reply, but looked at Johnson unusually calmly for a few seconds. Before Johnson raised his whip again, he silently followed the medicine slave in front of him with difficulty. He felt that every step weighed more than a thousand pounds and required a lot of energy from him.

After Shi Yan turned around, the wild laughter on Johnson's face gradually subsided, and instead showed a strange expression.

Along the way, there were many dishonest drug slaves who were "taken care of" by him at first, because of his cruel and vicious methods. Two drug slaves were beaten to death under his "care" before Karu tested the drugs. When all the drug slaves looked at him, there were two expressions in their eyes.

Only this person, when he looked at him just now, showed neither fear nor hatred, but was unusually calm, the kind of calm with a hint of coolness.

This man seemed to have no awareness of being a prisoner. I don't know if it was because he hadn't clearly understood the situation yet, or for some other reason.

That calm gaze gave Johnson the strange illusion that he had become someone else's prey, which made him very uncomfortable. However, because Shi Yan had already moved forward obediently, he could not find an excuse for the attack at the moment, so he could only give up, but he secretly swore in his heart that the boy who was "taking care of" from behind showed fear towards him.

He enjoyed the look of fear that others showed when they looked at him, which gave him the wonderful pleasure of being the master of other people's lives.

In the next few days, Shi Yan was taciturn, but extremely cooperative. He was asked to go and stop, without any resistance or emotion. He seemed to be indifferent to the things around him. Among the uncooperative medicine slaves, Shi Yan seemed very different.

Even Johnson, who wanted to teach Shi Yan a lesson, found it difficult to find an excuse to deal with him. Shi Yan was so cooperative that Johnson felt it was unreasonable, but he couldn't think of a reason why.

Shi Yan would only speak when he was taking a break to eat, and every time he would ask for food. Under Master Karu's instructions, his request was fulfilled every time.

Soon, those warriors discovered that Shi Yan was very good at eating. Even the low-quality food reserved for medicine slaves, he ate with gusto. The first food he ate was probably the sum of the seven medicine slaves. After that, his food intake would increase by one portion every day, and it would continue to increase.

This made many warriors find it incredible. They couldn't understand how Shi Yan's thin body could hold so much food. At first, these people were worried that Shi Yan would not be able to digest it, but they soon discovered that they were wrong.

Shi Yan's skinny body had quietly become stronger in a few days. Although the strength was not particularly obvious, all warriors with keen observation noticed this phenomenon.

Obviously, Shi Yan not only digested those low-quality foods, but also made those foods become nutrients for his body.

Shi Yan's physical changes made Master Karu very happy. This old man with gloomy eyes allowed Shi Yan to eat freely and boldly, and he must give him as much as he could eat without losing a cent.

Seeing Shi Yan getting stronger day by day, Johnson felt a little uneasy. Every time he saw Shi Yan's calm eyes with a hint of coolness, Johnson felt that this kid would be a disaster, but he did not dare to disobey Karu's instructions, so he could only provide Shi Yan with enough food without any deductions.

Fortunately, Johnson knew Master Kalu's methods, which made him somewhat reassured, and secretly hoped that Kalu would take action soon.

After eating food for twelve people in a row, Shi Yan stopped his movements, rolled up the last grain of rice at the corner of his mouth and swallowed it. Ignoring the surprised looks of the medicine slaves next to him, Shi Yan slowly closed his eyes.

The food for twelve people was quickly digested in the intestines and stomach. His body was like a bottomless pit, but also like the most sophisticated instrument, grinding and breaking down the food one by one, converting it into nutrients for blood tendons, bones, internal organs, and muscle cells, making his originally thin body become stronger quietly.

The wound on his chest healed very early. It only took a day and a half for such a long wound to heal without leaving any scars. It was so miraculous that he realized that he was indeed different from before.

Only he himself knew how much his body had changed in just a few days. He could clearly feel this change every moment!

The food he ate turned into nutrients for his body, making his body gradually stronger. The weak essence in his body had doubled in strength due to the continuous flow of it day and night in the past few days!

He clearly felt that there was a lot of strength in his body, and the shackles that were once as heavy as mountains were no longer a big burden on him.

With his mind concentrated, he clearly felt that the essence of essence in his body naturally started from the lower Dantian, followed the Du Meridian up, and went down along the Ren Meridian, passing through the three levels to communicate with Ren Du, making the heart and kidneys intersect, and the water and fire complement each other. After a small week, the essence of essence in his body became stronger again.

Shi Yan, who has some general knowledge of qigong, knows the difference between the large and small Zhou Tian. The small Zhou Tian only follows the two meridians of Ren and Du, and does not follow the twelve main meridians, nor the other six meridians of the other extraordinary meridians.

Of the twelve main meridians and the eight great miracle meridians, he only had the two meridians of Ren and Du, so he could only perform the small cycle, and the great cycle was difficult to circulate. From another memory of Shi Yan, he also knew that only warriors in the innate realm in this world could unblock the twelve great meridians and the eight great miracle meridians, and then perform the great cycle.

Shi Yan was not discouraged. He knew that as long as the essence in his body was strong enough, sooner or later all these blocked tendons could be opened.

"Another one died. In six days, two people have already died after trying the medicine."

"I saw it. Before the man died, his body had already started to rot. It was so miserable!"

"Instead of dying like this, it is better to commit suicide. There is no hope for living. We are destined to be like them."

"We can't commit suicide! If we die by suicide, our relatives won't even get a blue crystal coin! Hey... let's endure it. After half a year, we will be free if we don't die, and we can also get a sum of money. For the sake of our wives and children, we must continue to endure it!"

As soon as this medicine slave said these words, the other medicine slaves fell silent one by one. The idea of committing suicide seemed to be dispelled. They all suppressed the fear in their hearts and secretly told themselves that they must hold on.
